title: Physical Structure of Planetary Nebulae. I. The Owl Nebula

evidence.locator: Sect. III.1: the outer shell is almost circular, with a diameter of 218 arcsec; the inner shell is roughly confined by an ellipse of 182 x 168 arcsec with its major axis north-west to south-east. Fig. 5 and Sect. IV: the main nebula is a spherical outer shell and an ellipsoidal inner shell with a major-to-minor axis ratio of about 1.1; the inner shell has a bipolar cavity whose polar axis is tilted by about 30 degrees to the line of sight.
